title: Bench Press: No Banner only HULK Leaves Stafford and Kelce on the Pine and Still Flattens the Rookie
dek: Ramon's juggernaut went 2-0 with 47.58 points sitting idle, Sonny posted the week's top score, and Alan's Team Pillbert grabbed its first win with a familiar smirk.
body: The Week 2 game of the week was billed as the rookie against the juggernaut, and the juggernaut did not read the script. Ramon's No Banner only HULK beat Zoe's Ghostu-Spider SZN 131.92 to 82.8, a 49-point win as a 67% favorite. Josh Allen led the way with 40.82 points against a 22.65 projection, the best individual line in the league this week. The truly annoying part for everyone else is that Matthew Stafford (26.98) and Travis Kelce (20.6) combined for 47.58 points on Ramon's bench, so the HULK won comfortably while leaving a starting lineup's worth of production unused.

The numbers have caught up to the eye test. No Banner only HULK leads the league with 309.8 points through two weeks, its title odds climbed from 47% to 54%, and its playoff odds now read 100% in mid-September. Nobody else has title odds higher than 21%. At this point the other seven managers aren't chasing Ramon so much as hoping he forgets to set a lineup.

Zoe, meanwhile, got her first hard lesson in how fast this game turns. Saquon Barkley posted 2.5 points against a 16.38 projection, the kind of dud that sinks any team against an opponent scoring 131. Ghostu-Spider SZN's title odds collapsed from 13% to 1%, the biggest drop on the board, and its playoff odds sit at 24%. She did add Devaughn Vele off waivers without dropping anyone, so the rookie is already working the wire instead of waiting for Saquon to fix things on his own.

The highest score of the week belonged to the commissioner. Sonny's The Horse is Hea crushed Jordan's Counting or not Counting GV 142.46 to 82.08, powered by Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 38 points on a 15.22 projection. Even scarier, Patrick Mahomes scored 28.98 from Sonny's bench, so a 60-point blowout could have been uglier. The Horse is Hea is 2-0 and its title odds jumped from 4% to 10%. For Jordan, the math is grim for a manager who is here for the numbers: Malik Nabers delivered 0.6 points on a 12.26 projection, the team has scored a league-low 158 points in two weeks, and its playoff odds are down to 1%.

Alan's Team Pillbert got off the mat with a 135.48 to 109.66 win over Kaushal's Habibsters in what the model called a near coin flip at 51%. Davante Adams was the difference, scoring 35.5 against a 13.14 projection. Philly also kept tinkering, adding Jalen Coker for Tony Pollard and Isaiah Likely for Sam LaPorta. The bad guy's title odds leapt from 4% to 13%, which means the 1-1 villain now has better title odds than the 2-0 commissioner, and nobody is going to enjoy that more than Alan.

Kaushal has a right to feel cursed. CeeDee Lamb scored 31.3 and Dak Prescott added 29.76, a combined 61.06 from his Dallas duo, and Habibsters still lost by 25.82. His waiver activity was a blur: Jaguars D/ST to Buccaneers D/ST to 49ers D/ST and back to the Buccaneers, plus Deebo Samuel Sr. in for Wan'Dale Robinson and then Wan'Dale right back in for Deebo. Habib cycled through defenses faster than he has ever driven through Georgia, and he ended up roughly where he started. Habibsters have 218.3 points, more than 1-1 Ghostu-Spider SZN, but sit 0-2 with 15% playoff odds.

Randy's The fumblers stayed perfect by beating Mekhi's Dawgs 124.02 to 100.74 as a 69% favorite, but it wasn't the quarterback who did it. Caleb Williams went from last week's top scorer to this week's bust, posting 7.72 against a 19.42 projection. Amon-Ra St. Brown picked up the slack with 30.7. Oddly, The fumblers won and still saw title odds slide from 28% to 21%, mostly because the HULK keeps eating the pie. Mekhi swapped Carnell Tate for Kenyon Sadiq, but Dawgs are 0-2 with 9% playoff odds and a long climb ahead.

Week 3 hands Kaushal the worst possible cure for a two-game skid: Habibsters vs No Banner only HULK. Zoe gets Randy's The fumblers in a matchup with Packers-vs-Bears energy and a rookie looking to stop a slide. Sonny's The Horse is Hea, 2-0, faces Mekhi's winless Dawgs, and Jordan tries to find a first win against Alan's newly confident Team Pillbert. Three teams are unbeaten, three are winless, and only one of them looks like it's playing a different sport.

social.author: HULK Smash Society
social.text: Won by 49. Stafford and Kelce scored 47.58 on our bench. We were playing with the safety on.

social.author: Waiver Wire Wendy
social.text: Habibsters D/ST tracker: Jaguars, Bucs, 49ers, Bucs. Deebo in, Deebo out, Wan'Dale back. Kaushal's roster has more round trips than an airport shuttle.

social.author: The Horse is Hea Stable Boys
social.text: 142.46, top score of the week, and Mahomes put up 28.98 on the bench. The commish is 2-0 and still holding back.

social.author: Model Mike
social.text: Title odds check: Team Pillbert 1-1 at 13%, The Horse is Hea 2-0 at 10%. The computer has been bought. Probably by Alan.

social.author: Saquon Truthers Anonymous

social.author: BFL Insider Ike
social.text: Sources say Davante Adams' 35.5 on a 13.14 projection was the whole Team Pillbert game plan. Sources say it worked.

social.author: Fumblers Fan Frank
social.text: Caleb gives us 37 one week and 7.72 the next. Thank you, Amon-Ra, for 30.7 points of emotional support. 2-0 is 2-0.

social.author: Spreadsheet Steve
social.text: Counting or not Counting GV: 158 points in two weeks, Nabers 0.6, playoff odds 1%. The numbers are counting. They just don't like what they see.

social.text: 0-2 but Sadiq is in. Next up: the 2-0 commish. Time to make the Horse sweat.

bios.1: Sonny's team posted the week's top score with 142.46 and sits at 2-0 with 82% playoff odds. Jaxon Smith-Njigba went off for 38, and Mahomes scoring 28.98 on the bench suggests even more upside. Title odds more than doubled to 10%.
bios.2: Randy's squad is 2-0 with 270.2 points, second-best in the league, and 92% playoff odds. Caleb Williams cooled off hard in Week 2, but Amon-Ra St. Brown carried the load. Title odds dipped to 21% even with the win, mostly because of the green giant at the top.
bios.3: Jordan's team is 0-2 with a league-low 158 points and 1% playoff odds after an 82.08 showing against Sonny. Malik Nabers' 0.6 points summed up the week. Team Pillbert is next, and a first win would do wonders for the spreadsheet.
bios.4: Alan bounced back with a 135.48 win behind Davante Adams' 35.5 points and kept churning the roster with Jalen Coker and Isaiah Likely. At 1-1, Team Pillbert's title odds jumped from 4% to 13%, higher than one of the unbeatens. Jordan's winless squad is up next.
bios.5: Mekhi's squad is 0-2 after falling to The fumblers 124.02 to 100.74, with playoff odds down to 9%. He swapped Carnell Tate for Kenyon Sadiq looking for a spark. A date with the unbeaten commissioner is a chance to flip the script.
bios.6: Kaushal's team has scored 218.3 points, more than a 1-1 team, yet sits 0-2 with 15% playoff odds. CeeDee Lamb and Dak Prescott combined for 61.06 and it still wasn't enough. A whirlwind of D/ST swaps hasn't changed the luck, and No Banner only HULK looms next.
bios.7: Ramon's juggernaut is 2-0 with a league-best 309.8 points, 54% title odds, and 100% playoff odds after two weeks. Josh Allen has been a monster, and the bench alone could probably win some matchups. Habibsters are next in line to try to slow it down.
bios.8: Zoe's debut-week magic ran into the HULK, and Saquon Barkley's 2.5 points didn't help. The rookie is 1-1 with title odds down from 13% to 1% and playoff odds at 24%. She's already working waivers with Devaughn Vele as she gets ready for The fumblers.
